text:
amira: Heads-up — ran an nsys capture inside our inference container and the GPU kernel names are all ???? in the timeline. No file/line info either. Anyone seen this before?

jon: which nsys command and container image?

amira: ran: `nsys profile -o /tmp/run.nsys --trace=nvtx,cuda,cublas ./serve --config ./cfg.yaml` inside docker:runtime-prod:2026-02-18

devin: common causes: CUPTI not available in the container, or libcupti ABI mismatch with the host driver. Also stripped binaries will remove symbols for host-side stacks.

mike: do you get missing symbols only for our own shared libs or also for CUDA kernels? nvtx ranges show, but kernel entries show `<[CUDA_KERNEL]>` with no name?

amira: exact output: ```
Timeline: kernel name: ??? (0x7f8a3c)  // repeated for dozens of kernels
Host stack: main+0x12a -> serve.cpp:??
```

lea: FYI our release Dockerfile runs `strip --strip-all` on the daemon. That will remove debug info. In many traces that kills symbol resolution for host frames. Suggest building with `RelWithDebInfo` and avoid full strip.

jon: also check CUPTI version: inside container run `ldd $(ldconfig -p | grep libcupti | awk '{print $4}' | head -n1)` or `ls -l /usr/local/cuda/extras/CUPTI/lib64` — if the container's libcupti doesn't match host driver, nsys may not resolve kernel names.

devin: another gotcha: when we run inside container but use NVIDIA Container Toolkit, the driver is from the host. If the container lacks /usr/local/cuda/extras/CUPTI or has an older cupti, CUPTI APIs may return limited metadata. Mounting host CUPTI into the container fixes it: `-v /usr/local/cuda/extras/CUPTI:/usr/local/cuda/extras/CUPTI:ro`

mike: can you paste the Dockerfile snippet? maybe the build step strips before we copy debug symbols into /usr/lib/debug.

amira: snippet: ```
FROM ubuntu:22.04
# build
RUN cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release .. && make -j8
RUN strip --strip-all /opt/serve/bin/serve
```

lea: yep that's the culprit for host-side symbols. For CUDA kernel names you still need CUPTI and matching driver. Recommended docker build changes: `CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo` and remove the strip line; optionally run `objcopy --only-keep-debug` to keep separate .debug files.

perf-ci: CI note: reproduced on perf runner: https://perf.example.com/runs/1762003400 (artifact: run.nsys) — shows same missing kernel names.

sre-bot: Automated check: host driver 535.86, container libcupti 12.1.0 (mismatch).

devin: if you can't change image, at least bind-mount host CUPTI and libcuda: `docker run --gpus all -v /usr/local/cuda/extras/CUPTI:/usr/local/cuda/extras/CUPTI:ro -v /var/run/nvidia-persistenced:/var/run/nvidia-persistenced:ro ...` Also ensure `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` includes the mounted cupti path.

jon: another tip: build with `-g -rdynamic` so that dynamic loader exports symbol table for backtraces; nsys uses that for host call stacks.

amira: tried mounting host CUPTI and rebuilt `RelWithDebInfo` — kernel names returned and host frames show file/line. Nice.

mike: add to docs: checklist for perf captures in containers — CUPTI present + version match, RelWithDebInfo or separate debug symbols, avoid strip, mount host CUDA when necessary, include nvtx ranges for easier correlation.

amira: thanks all — I'll push a short runbook and a PR to fix the Dockerfile. :thumbsup:
